warning_source: Israel Air Force command and intelligence officers
recipient: Military Intelligence / Unit 8200 senior personnel; exact recipients unresolved
warning_summary: Months before Oct. 7 the IAF reportedly warned that its Gaza intelligence picture was insufficient and that Unit 8200 was retaining intelligence, analysis and assessments rather than sharing them; the complaint triggered several senior coordination meetings and a joint intelligence-cooperation plan.
evidence_state: N12 investigative reporting (17 Aug 2024) says IAF commander Maj. Gen. Tomer Bar and intelligence officers raised the deficiency months before Oct. 7 and quotes a senior IAF officer telling AMAN that '8200 has become a warehouse.' Later secondary summaries place a final senior meeting about a week before the attack.
gaps: No public minutes, exact warning dates, complete participant/recipient list or underlying correspondence recovered. It is also unresolved whether this was framed as a disaster/readiness warning rather than a systemic intelligence-sharing complaint. Do not Accept without stronger event-level documentation.

recipient: Gaza Division/base commanders; pre-Oct. 7 recipient of formal results unresolved
warning_summary: A General Staff base-security inspection reportedly found that nearly every Gaza Division post tested could be penetrated, including Nahal Oz, where inspectors reached operations/surveillance areas and could access weapons/classified material.
evidence_state: N12 (1 May 2024) identifies the 4 Oct 06:30 exercise as a General Staff inspection and reports broad failures; Times of Israel independently summarized the findings. The IDF said it was a routine camp-defense inspection intended to improve base security, not a simulation of a surprise mass invasion by thousands.
gaps: No public distribution list, report, briefing record or evidence that the findings reached a qualifying senior state/security decision-maker before Oct. 7. Keep Investigating; do not infer the findings were ignored.

warning_source: Gaza-border surveillance soldiers and IDF engineering/security personnel
recipient: Gaza Division headquarters and Southern Command headquarters
warning_summary: Hamas was systematically testing explosives and other activity relevant to breaching the Gaza barrier; a professional assessment warned the pattern was broader than routine provocation.
evidence_state: Canonical Notion entry updated with Times of Israel 17 Sep 2026 reporting on the formal dismissal of Gaza Division intelligence officer Lt. Col. 'Aleph'; the report additionally says he was said to have disregarded surveillance-soldier warning signs present at least three months before Oct. 7, including repeated Hamas training, digging and placement of explosives. This strengthens the broader warning/response pattern.
gaps: The 2026 report does not independently establish the exact wording or distribution list of the specific September explosive-testing assessment. Confidence remains Medium.

warning_summary: Four Military Intelligence warning documents were formally confirmed as delivered to Netanyahu between March and July 2023.
evidence_state: Canonical Notion already contains distinct accepted entries for the known March, 31 May, 16 July and 23 July warning-document chain, including the 31 May document; the stale umbrella candidate therefore should not be treated as evidence of a missing May event.
gaps: Full original metadata/text and an authoritative chronology tying every document to the four-document FOIA count remain incomplete; retain only as a documentary-recovery umbrella, not a new warning event.
